{{Top|leg}}
The '''Special Operations barracks''', also known as '''Special Operations Unit barracks''', or the '''501st Special Unit barracks''' was the official base of the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], which was a part of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. The barracks was located within the [[501st Legion headquarters]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
